Birthdays
Kept permanently, whatever happens to the crew list. Signing off, importing a new list over the old one or changing ship does not remove anyone — only Remove here does. Everyone added to the crew list with a date of birth is recorded automatically.
One-off jobs for the work planner — something that came up on the day and was never on the to do list. Anything you close out on the to do list already goes onto that day's planner by itself; this is only for the extras.
Everything ticked WR on the to do list lands here on its own. Add anything else that was done straight in below — it is saved as an ordinary completed job, so it also shows on the to do list as done, photos and all.

Converter
Tap a line to copy it.
0
Percent is a suffix: 50% is 0.5, and 200×5% is 10. Ans is the last result. Powers are right to left, so 2^3^2 is 512, and −2² is −4 — the minus is applied after the square, as it is in writing.

World map
Instruments
A reference shelf for the makers' manuals: each instrument holds its procedures and its spare parts list, to be read while you work. It keeps no log — the ship's log is the record. Everything here comes from the maker's manual and stays on this device.
ETA
Tap a line to copy it. The selected speed is highlighted.
Information
From a photo of the particulars: open the photo in Photos, press and hold the text, Copy — then paste below and tap Read. Recognised lines fill the fields underneath.
Signing off
Writes everything for this ship — jobs, crew, cargo log, port calls, the ship’s particulars and every photograph — into one file, keeps a copy in the app so you can look back at it, then clears the app for the next ship. Birthdays are kept: they are a register of people, not of a ship.
